prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and preferred working style. To help you find the best fit, tell me a few quick things and I’ll give a tailored shortlist and next steps.

Questions
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce sales, product launch, PR, etc.)
- What services do you need? (SEO, paid ads, content, social, creative/branding, PR, web design, marketing automation, B2B demand gen)
- Industry or audience? (tech, healthcare, education, government, consumer goods, local consumers, national audience)
- Budget range and timeline?
- Do you prefer a large/full‑service firm or a smaller boutique/agency partner?
- Are you okay with remote agencies or want someone local (e.g., Baltimore, Annapolis, Montgomery County)?

What I can do next
- If you answer the questions above I’ll give a short, prioritized list of Maryland agencies that match your needs (with why each is a fit and suggested starter questions to ask them).
- Or, if you want an immediate general list, I can provide well‑regarded Maryland agencies by specialty (digital, PR, B2B, etc.).

Which would you like?
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
